registered_before: reading any pulse-stable-refreshed data (campaign started 13:56, capture ends 22/10 ~12:30) and before any tree_ae number
context: baseline-evaluation-v1 on pulse-live-recalibrated (development, SENTINEL_PULSE_STATUS 5.15a): the autoencoder matched or beat base29 on recall at every budget with far lower alert burden and latency, but flagged benign launches ~100%; base29 separated benign launches better. This is the fresh-data test.

models.frozen: no refit: base29 = feature-groups study base29 (reproduces syscall-arms base29); iforest / autoencoder / freq_profile = /var/tmp/baselines/models on .234

arms.tree_ae: new, defined after seeing the development autoencoder result: Pulse's tree branch (history -> current ExtraTrees) with the autoencoder score as the second branch in place of the support branch; joint p = min(1, 2 min(tree_p, ae_p)); seeds paired

evaluation_data.normal: pulse-stable-refreshed normal from campaign end + 60 s to capture end (last worker TERMINAL), minus spans listed in analysis/EXTRA_EXCLUDE if that file is written from run-health evidence before any normal number is read; first 42 % calibration, rest alert burden
evaluation_data.attacks: pulse-stable-refreshed campaign (idle control, benign launch, attack)

decision: k2of2, alpha scale matched per arm to the budget (grid 0.5-30), paired workload-clustered bootstrap (10000) of differences to base29
reported_as: per baseline-evaluation-v1: base29 better / not different / worse on recall and separation at budgets 1 and 5

adoption_rule.rule: a candidate becomes the next Pulse scorer candidate only if at budget 1 on this fresh data: recall difference to base29 point >= 0 and 95 % CI lower bound >= -0.01; separation (recall - benign rate) difference point >= 0 and 95 % CI lower bound >= -0.05; p95 first-alarm delay <= 2.0 s. If both pass, the larger separation difference wins. Otherwise base29 stays.
adoption_rule.still_required_after_adoption: a live run with the adopted scorer before any claim about live behaviour

evidence_class: fresh normal and fresh campaign for every arm (models frozen 21/10 13:53); attack scenarios are the same self-written fixtures as in development
